info.name: GridWise - Smart Campus Energy Optimization API
info.description:
Official comprehensive testing collection for GridWise (BUP CSE Fest 2026 Preliminary Round).

Covers:
1. Service Health Readiness probe (`GET /health`)
2. Official Public Sample Cases 01-10 (`POST /optimize-energy`)
3. Strict Pydantic Firewall Error Testing (HTTP 400 Bad Request)
4. Edge Cases and Arbitrage Boundary Tests

Compatible with Postman and Newman CLI.
